about_the_game:
Virtual Avatar Starter Pack is a software developed for those who are preparing for virtual broadcasting for the first time.

It is a one-person development software, so there are some shortcomings.

We developed the software to reduce excessive expenses and create an environment where many people can easily challenge themselves in order to verify talent in virtual broadcasting.

We developed it for those who want concepts such as Scifi, Zombie, and Creature, rather than the currently popular animation-style characters.

We developed it based on the principle of implementing essential functions rather than many functions.

If you need advanced functions and avatars, you need to switch to other software that is suitable for you.

• Equipment other than a webcam is not supported for face and hand recognition.

• External file import such as VRM, live2D is not supported.

• Virtual Avatar Starter Pack provides approximately 170 3D avatars, approximately 160 360 Skybox environment maps,

Voice change filter, background color designation for chroma key, and camera effect functions.

• For human-type avatars, simplified face tracking and hand tracking are supported using a webcam.

• For animal and creature-type avatars, head rotation and mouth tracking are supported using a webcam.

• For drone-type avatars, head rotation tracking is supported using a webcam.
